title.zh: 查询已绑定的号码或商家账号ID列表
title.en: Query List of Bound Phone Numbers or Merchant Account IDs

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口查询流程绑定的手机号码或商家账号ID列表，也可在[**流程编辑器**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)>**设置**界面查看流程绑定的手机号码或商家账号ID列表。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您创建的流程已绑定手机号码或商家账号ID。

- 若您创建的流程未绑定手机号码或商家账号ID，可在[**流程编辑器**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)>**设置**界面手动绑定手机号码或商家账号ID或通过[FlowBindPhone](~~2937190~~)接口绑定手机号码或商家账号ID。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to query the phone numbers or business account IDs attached to a flow. You can also view this information on the **Settings** page in the **Flow Editor**.

- Before you call this operation, ensure that a phone number or business account ID is attached to your flow.

- If a phone number or business account ID is not attached to your flow, you can attach one manually on the **Settings** page in the **Flow Editor** or by calling the [FlowBindPhone](~~2937190~~) operation.
